text: Code reviews are an essential practice in software development. When developers review each other's code before it is merged, they can catch bugs early, which saves time and money later. Code reviews also support knowledge sharing, because team members learn from each other's solutions and discover parts of the system they may not know well. In addition, regular reviews improve overall team quality by encouraging clear, consistent code. Although code reviews take extra time, they help teams build better software together and avoid repeating the same mistakes.
